messages:
marta-evans: Heads-up — OrbitalPay pulse looks bad. MAU down ~62% over last 7d, seats show a big inactive cluster. Dashboard: https://redwood.app/d/usage/orbitalpay (check user_activity).
ashok-singh: ugh. any prod issues? billing? SSO?
eng-bot: Alert: auth-5xx spike detected 2026-03-20T11:12:02Z — ~4x baseline. trace_id=abc123 (automated).
jordan_ng: i'm seeing the drop kick in right after 2026-03-14 in the logs — account notes have a "procurement: shortlist" flag around that time. smells like vendor evaluation.
marta-evans: also heard their main advocate (cto-lead) left last week per the CSM call — that explains the sudden drop.
lisa-csm: @marta-evans i'll own outreach. suggested play: 1) quick ops check, 2) offer a 2-week dedicated trial + credits, 3) schedule a sync with the new eng lead. drafting email now.
ashok-singh: Ops check done — infra healthy, no token/QPS degradation besides the auth 5xx. quick query for inactive users: ```SELECT user_id, last_active FROM events WHERE account = 'orbitalpay' AND last_active < now() - interval '14 days';```
jordan_ng: agree on trial + credits. suggest we also run a tiny micro-benchmark to show latency/cost benefits (low lift, high signal) during the trial.
marta-evans: perfect. lisa, can you drop the email draft here so AE/AMs can iterate? i'll loop them after.
lisa-csm: draft:
> Hi <Name>,
>
> Noticed a dip in activity for your team — wanted to check in. Can we hop on a quick 20m call to review what changed and propose a short dedicated trial so we can run a quick cost/latency demo?
>
> Available Tue/Thu mornings PT. — Lisa (CSM)
Posting here for edits :pencil2:
ashok-singh: :thumbsup: i'll prep the dedicated trial env and reserved token. need AE + legal signoff for credits — pinging them after this thread. @jordan_ng can you prepare the micro-benchmark?
jordan_ng: on it. will run candidate model variants and share numbers by EOD.
marta-evans: :eyes: thanks team. i'll schedule once lisa confirms times and will include procurement + new eng lead on the invite.
lisa-csm: scheduled 2026-03-22 10:00 PT — invite went to new-eng-lead@orbitalpay.com and procurement contact. will post meeting notes after call.
